Herb or Spice

Sage

About This Entry

Dried sage brings musky eucalyptus depth to brown butter, poultry stuffing, and Italian saltimbocca — its assertive herb pairs with Chardonnay, Verdicchio, and earthy reds.

Wine Pairing Explanation

Primary wine styles

  • syrah shiraz

Alternative wine styles

  • nebbiolo

Why These Wines Work

Syrah Shiraz — Sage resinous savory herb suits Syrah in brown butter, saltimbocca, and roast accent.

Nebbiolo — Sage in saltimbocca also pairs with Nebbiolo tar and acid.

Herbal — Sage resinous savory aligns with herbal structured red fruit.

Common Culinary Uses

  • chicken breast
  • marjoram
  • pork loin
